title: Capture and correlate opt-in Engram control phase traces in TermAl
outcome: Provide bounded opt-in control-process stderr diagnostics correlated to actual subprocess instances and frame attempts, including timeout/kill gaps, without changing control/admission semantics.
acceptance: Diagnostic output contains only the agreed allowlisted fields, distinguishes host observations from child reports, records timing scope and loss accurately, and exposes useful bounded evidence for an admission timeout.

Frame correlation matches the documented startup, invalid/blank/oversize/EOF-tail, partial-write/read-failure, process-replacement and spawn-race cases; completed responses are not used as a proxy for consumed frames.

Opt-in Engram control stderr traces are captured with bounded line, queue and retention budgets, drained independently of control stdout, and associated with a fresh per-spawn instance identity and serialized frame-attempt sequence; missing, malformed, oversized or dropped trace data remains explicitly unknown.

Regression tests exercise the production capture/lifecycle paths, slow or blocked stderr, timeout/kill and trace-disabled behavior, proving bounded memory and unchanged control responses and admission behavior; the full gate passes on the final input.
